mission.heading: M0 Craft
mission.body: Become a world-class independent product designer.

mission.heading: M1 Health
mission.body: Rebuild an aerobic base after a sedentary decade.

mission.heading: M2 Wealth
mission.body: Hold a 12-month runway and carry zero consumer debt.

goals.text: Land 3 retainer clients for Northslope Studio by December. Two conversations are live, one proposal is out, and the pipeline needs steady outreach to hold the pace.
Run a sub-55 minute 10K in October. Base mileage is climbing and the tempo work starts this week.
Reach a 6-month emergency fund by November. $12,400 of the $18,000 target is set aside.
Publish 24 essays this year. Eleven are live and the drafting cadence is holding at roughly one a fortnight.
Ship Fieldnote v1, a personal notes app, to the first cohort of testers.

problems.heading: P0 Feast-famine income
problems.body: Independent income arrives in bursts, which makes planning hard.

problems.heading: P1 Low-energy afternoons
problems.body: Focus dips after lunch and eats into deep work.

problems.heading: P2 Notes everywhere
problems.body: Notes live across four apps with no single source of truth.

strategies.heading: S0 Steady outreach
strategies.body: Send four tailored studio pitches every week and nurture warm leads on a cadence.

strategies.heading: S1 Base then speed
strategies.body: Build easy aerobic mileage first, add one tempo session a week from July.

strategies.heading: S2 Automate the runway
strategies.body: Route a fixed share of every invoice straight into the emergency fund.

strategies.heading: S3 One essay a fortnight
strategies.body: Protect a two-hour drafting block and ship on a schedule, not on inspiration.

narratives.heading: N0 The independent leap
narratives.body: A senior product designer trading a salary for a studio and a longer runway.

narratives.heading: N1 Compounding quietly
narratives.body: Small daily reps on health, writing, and craft that add up over a year.

challenges.heading: C0 Afternoon slump
challenges.body: Energy fades after lunch and the hardest work gets pushed to a tired brain.

challenges.heading: C1 Context switching
challenges.body: Client work, product work, and writing compete for the same mornings.

challenges.heading: C2 Runway anxiety
challenges.body: Lumpy income makes it tempting to over-index on billable hours.

beliefs: Consistency beats intensity for anything that compounds over a year.
A short runway makes you take bad clients; a long one lets you say no.
The tool you actually open beats the perfect tool you never launch.
Aerobic base is boring to build and impossible to fake.
Writing in public is the fastest way to sharpen your thinking.

models.heading: Compound Interest
models.body: Growth accelerates when returns are reinvested; the same logic governs skills, audience, and savings.

models.heading: Via Negativa
models.body: Improvement often comes from removing what harms rather than adding what helps.

wisdom.heading: Focus
wisdom.body: The morning is for the work that only you can do; everything else waits for the afternoon.

wisdom.heading: Runway
wisdom.body: Save first, spend what remains; the emergency fund is the price of creative freedom.

books: The Timeless Way of Building — Christopher Alexander. Re-read for how living structure emerges from small, repeated design motifs.
Deep Work — Cal Newport. The two-hour morning block is straight out of this.
Your Money or Your Life — a runway is really a measure of freedom, not fear.
